'''Weapons officer''' was a rank held within the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]]. During the events of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], [[Turl Nevil]] held the rank of Weapons officer onboard the ''[[Cheesmeer]]'', a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]], prior to his death during the [[Battle of the rendezvous point]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
